name: Mazagoan Dock Shipbuilders Ltd.
about: Mazagon Dock Shipbuilders Limited engages in the building and repairing of ships, submarines, vessels, and related engineering products in India and internationally. The company operates in two segments, Shipbuilding, and Submarine and Heavy Engineering. The company offers cargo ships, passenger ships, supply vessels, multipurpose support vessels, water tankers, tugs, dredgers, fishing trawlers, barges, and border outposts. It also provides services, including repairs and refit, designing of ships, know how provider, training, tug support, supply chain management, and self-propeller modular transporter. In addition, it offers offshore patrol vessels, fast patrol vessels, and floating boarder outposts.
